full_judgment: 2. The learned Subordinate Judge, Sirajgonj on 11-11-89 decreed OC Suit No. 32 of 1987 on contest against the petitioner and others declaring plaintiff-respondent Nos. 1-4's title to the suit property and also declaring that the same is not vested property. The learned District Judge, Sirajgonj by his judgment and decree dated 30-11-94 affirmed the decree of the trial Court in dismissing OC Appeal No. 143 of 1989, preferred by the present petitioner. Against the said decree of the lower appellate Court the petitioner moved the aforesaid revisional application before the High Court Division.
